steps.name: 梳理 Automatically upgrade workflow profile to standard for high level tasks or spec requirements
steps.description: 根据 spec 明确 FR-1: Automatically upgrade workflow profile to standard for high level tasks or spec requirements 的实现边界和验收口径。
steps.acceptance: AC-1: When a backlog item or task is level 2/3, requires a spec, or includes major-change categories such as workflow/agent behavior, architecture/module boundaries, API/data contracts, permissions, or long-term maintenance cost, DocPath resolves the workflow profile to standard. Existing quick/low-risk level 0/1 flows remain unchanged unless one of those indicators is present. Routing, status, plan/go/check behavior, and user-facing hints explain the upgrade reason. Tests cover quick compatibility, level-based upgrade, spec-required upgrade, and major-change upgrade. Because this changes workflow/agent behavior, implementation must include a Decision Brief and explicit user confirmation before go.
